target: Let each explicitly registered project evidence owner maintain bounded current project context across trusted devices.
primary_semantics: A device-local owner binds one explicit source root and closed evidence selection to immutable project evidence generations; deterministic maintenance creates a successor only after selected files are stable and changed.
invariants: Raw conversations, summaries, archive-v1, and environment-v1 remain unchanged.
Project source roots remain device-local and are never exported.
Owners never scan a whole workspace or discover files outside the explicit selection.
No-change refresh creates no generation, event, receipt, backup, or model call.
Every changed generation names the current local predecessor and preserves exact bytes.
Incoming evidence remains read-only and never creates a local owner.
The five-minute scheduler is model-free and bounded.
allowed_changes: Add project evidence owner schema, local owner registry, CLI, bounded maintenance integration, dashboard controls and status, tests, architecture registration, and synchronized documentation.
prohibited_changes: Automatic Rule or Skill installation or activation.
Persisting source-root paths in exchanged packages or peer replicas.
Publishing or installing before the frozen candidate passes the full release gate.
before_after_checks: Registering an owner twice is idempotent.
An unchanged source produces zero persistent mutations.
A stable selected-file change produces exactly one successor generation.
A changing, missing, oversized, linked, secret-bearing, or conflicting source produces no partial generation.
Maintenance restart resumes safely without duplicate generations.
macOS and Windows dashboards expose equivalent owner state and controls.
Rollback to 2.13.0 preserves all existing evidence generations and archives.

original_triggers: A persistent owner must not turn explicit project evidence into workspace scanning.
Background refresh must be idempotent, bounded, cross-platform, and effect-verified.
